gen-dafont-starborn-gf-almendra: Dreamy, drifting, widely spaced. Starborn floats above Almendra, whose serif body has a deep midsection that anchors each line like a bookish counterweight.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-bree-serif: Wispy and starlit, with dark lowercase. Starborn earns its keep when it runs big and short, while Bree Serif, a classic serif, takes the quieter work beneath.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-quando: Hazy, gapped-out and dreamy. Starborn works best big and brief up top, and Quando follows with sparse, widely spaced serif letters and a tall middle zone.
gen-dafont-starborn-outfit: Outfit reads clean and approachable, its sans-serif curves stopping short of closing, like bent cable. Against Starborn's spaced-out, ghostly heading, that tidy line is the whole appeal.
gen-dafont-starborn-plus-jakarta-sans: Spacey, soft-edged and a bit unreal. Plus Jakarta Sans keeps a monoline sans-serif stroke with curve endings held well apart, so a long stretch under Starborn reads crisp and modern.
gen-dafont-starborn-sora: Starborn throws huge gaps between its letters and stacks a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line. Sora sits underneath with a shorter lowercase and a precise, geometric sans, and its c and s stay widely parted.
gen-dafont-starborn-space-grotesk: Starborn is all dreamy gaps and heavy lowercase, with some thick-and-thin play in its lines. Space Grotesk drops that variation entirely, so a long passage reads as smooth, constant ribbon.
gen-dafont-stencilia-fs-amulya: Stencilia brings a structural, striking look, with spacious gaps at its curve terminals and a tight band of lowercase. Amulya follows in a contemporary sans, its curves staying generous and its lowercase a bit lower.
gen-dafont-stencilia-fs-chillax: Chillax reads casual and relaxed, its sans line looping like spaghetti with curves left unfinished where the pen lifted. And Stencilia, cut like sign-shop vinyl with a taller lowercase, gives that looseness a firm, structural frame.
gen-dafont-stencilia-fs-plein: Stencilia looks cut from a template, structural and striking, with gaps left open at its curve ends. Plein, a plain sans, gives a longer read a reliable, clean feel, with a clear channel into each round letter.
